sprites.concept: Claude-synced companion layer: this mask is already pure white at low alpha (a translucent glow bloom), so brightness/lerp are no-ops here (RGB already saturated). The executor's alpha op is a cap (min(a,value)), never a boost, so the base alpha (38) is the ceiling — re-expressed glowstick_lit's 'body' breathe as an alpha pulse that dips below and returns toward that ceiling, same rhythm, so the bloom breathes in lockstep with the visible chemlight body.
Claude-synced companion layer: mirrors carp_statue_eyes's 'eyes' dim/shut/flare beat, applied to the teeth's own single-color mask, so the whole guardian face flickers together.
